story.title: How it all began
story.paragraphOne: What started as a chance encounter became the most beautiful story of our lives. Merle and Lasse met when life had other plans – and yet everything felt exactly as it was meant to be.
story.paragraphTwo: Together we have laughed, argued, travelled and dreamed. Every moment together is a gift. And now we cannot wait to celebrate the most beautiful day with the people who mean the most to us.
story.quote: I choose you – today, tomorrow and all the days after.
